title: Fix Canvas Export Order in Sketchpad
description: Sketchpad.tsx exports Canvas, HorizontalWindows, VerticalWindows at line 11365 before they are imported at line 11406, causing a babel parse error. Need to fix the export/import order.
summary: Fixed babel parse error where Canvas, HorizontalWindows, VerticalWindows were exported before being imported. Changed bare `export { Canvas, HorizontalWindows, VerticalWindows }` to `export { Canvas, HorizontalWindows, VerticalWindows } from "@compose/ui"` (re-export syntax) and removed the now-redundant separate import statement.
